co_reactant.title: A fixed co-reactant hides the reaction pathway
co_reactant.new_label: Change c to 0.1; same observation time
co_reactant.explanation: At c = 1, the data identify only a + b.
co_reactant.intervention: Changing c separates the two library columns.
co_reactant.provenance: New deterministic STLSQ mechanism control; exact noiseless derivatives; NOT part of the 4,224-task benchmark

pde_mode.title: One spatial mode hides the diffusion order
pde_mode.new_label: Change initial field to cos(2x); same time
pde_mode.explanation: On cos(x), u_xx and -u_xxxx are identical library columns.
pde_mode.intervention: A second spatial mode scales these terms differently.
pde_mode.provenance: New deterministic STLSQ mechanism control; exact noiseless derivatives; NOT part of the 4,224-task benchmark

limit_cycle.title: A limit cycle hides the restoring mechanism
limit_cycle.new_label: Start off the cycle: r(0) = 0.3; same time
limit_cycle.initial_equation: r' = a r - b r^3  (known rotation omitted)
limit_cycle.explanation: On r = 1, radial growth and saturation cancel exactly.
limit_cycle.intervention: An off-cycle initial state reveals radial recovery.
limit_cycle.provenance: New deterministic STLSQ mechanism control; exact noiseless derivatives; NOT part of the 4,224-task benchmark
